turns.speaker: learner
turns.text: Excuse me, do you have a minute? I did not understand the part about the deadline.

turns.speaker: navi
turns.text: 当然。论文周五午夜截止，but you can ask for an extension，如果你需要的话。

turns.speaker: learner
turns.text: So can I submit it on Monday?

turns.speaker: navi
turns.text: 只要你周五之前给我发邮件 and ask for an extension 就行。说明一下原因，我一般都会同意。
